composition.observation: The daily activity card sits below monthly budget metrics within the existing Admiralty shell. Current desktop and mobile screenshots show a single metric selector and one chart, while the canonical account dossier contains the existing allowance panel. Historical fe5 populated charts supplement current zero-ledger captures; they are not current camera evidence.

hierarchy.observation: AI Usage & Quotas precedes monthly totals, budget watch, daily activity and outcome/provider cards. The dossier starts with the selected account identity and places AI usage and quotas below account security context. Requests, settled cost and accounted spending are distinct choices with UTC explanations.

typography.observation: Cream serif page/card headings and readable sans-serif values separate titles from labels and explanations. Mobile cost values remain readable at full resolution. The long account dossier wraps the synthetic account name instead of crowding its heading.

spacing.observation: Daily chart title, selector, explanatory sentence and four metrics retain separate rows on mobile. Allowance inputs have separate labels and adequate vertical spacing. The narrow request-history table uses a contained horizontal region rather than widening the page.

controls.observation: The actual recorded keyboard journey changes Chart shows to settled cost, then accounted spending and back to requests. People search uses the canonical Search input/button and selected account link. The dossier exposes inherited monthly allowance, spending, rate, eligibility and expiry inputs; current capture does not mutate policy.

contrast.observation: Light cream headings, pale body text and a bright cyan focus ring are distinguishable against the dark green cards. Empty charts explicitly say there are no settled costs or requests, so absence of bars is not interpreted through color alone.

consistency.observation: The account header and gold/green Admiralty navigation remain in the gateway shell family. Daily metric descriptions use the same UTC day admission convention. Canonical People search and dossier reuse the account authority instead of adding a separate AI account finder.

states.observation: Current captures explicitly establish settled, accounted, requests-returned, selected dossier and People-returned states on both devices. The zero ledger shows zero requests and $0.00 with an honest no-activity message. Historical fe5 populated and preview/apply/restore controls remain separately identified.

responsive.observation: At 390px the monthly metrics and allowance fields wrap inside the card; daily metrics become a two-column group. The history table has more columns than visible width and stays contained. Full-resolution mobile crops show no page-wide overflow; current recorded accessibility checks agree.

keyboard.observation: Current actual journeys use keyboard activation for metric selection and People navigation on both devices. The current mobile trace snapshot independently includes tabindex=0, role=region and aria-label=Account AI request history on the horizontal table wrapper. This removes the former keyboard-inaccessible overflow region; the recording does not itself demonstrate a horizontal arrow-key scroll.

focus.observation: Current settled-chart mobile screenshot has a conspicuous cyan focus ring around Chart shows, and returned People screenshot focuses the page heading. Post-experience narrow source confirms the repaired request-history region has tabIndex 0 and the shared scroll:focus-visible rule adds a 2px outline. Current dossier axe serious results are empty.

feedback.observation: Selecting a metric changes the figure title and cost explanation and preserves displayed totals. Search opens the named synthetic account dossier, and return clears back to Start with a known clue. Current capture supplies no timed feedback boundary for Admiralty, so no independent latency claim is made.

motion.observation: The reduced-motion desktop and mobile recordings preserve metric meaning and return navigation without relying on animation. Capture metadata confirms the requested reduced-motion preference. Sampled recording frames support transition meaning, not continuous playback smoothness or physical-device timing.

continuity.observation: Administrator identity remains visible through AI Usage, canonical People, account dossier and return. The recordings and capture receipt verify authorized Administrator role and return paths. Canonical dossier identity is Synthetic Parallax Creator; the session itself remains the operator.

complexity.observation: A single Chart shows selector exposes the three daily metrics; an optional exact table supplements the chart. Existing People search supplies a bounded account result and an existing dossier, limiting parallel navigation. The long dossier remains complex existing account context rather than a new AI-only administrative surface.

role-outcomes.observation: The authenticated operator can compare requests and daily cost representations and reach the selected account inherited allowance through ordinary People search. Current actual protected captures show the canonical controls and return; historical populated fe5 imagery demonstrates nonzero distinctions without relabeling it current.

fallbacks.observation: Current no-activity states disclose zero costs and no requests; provider status states that OpenAI credential is not configured. Blank per-account allowance fields visibly inherit policy, and the UI explains export metadata excludes retained prompts/proposals. No production invoice or real private account evidence is claimed.

findings.observation: Initial f6 packet did not retain the required canonical People allowance journey; this was missing proof, not proof of a nonfunctional account workflow.
findings.resolution: Current protected desktop/mobile recordings and dossier/People return screenshots establish ordinary canonical People search, selected inherited allowance controls and return. Historical fe5 captures additionally show preview/apply/restore without creating a separate account finder.

findings.observation: Initial f6 daily choices and exact-table captures were desktop only, leaving the mobile outcome unsupported.
findings.resolution: Current protected mobile captures record each metric and return with no page overflow. Historical fe5 mobile nonzero requests/settled/accounted images include expanded exact table; runtime changes since fe5 affect focus styling only and do not change metric presentation.

findings.observation: Initial f6 described a populated five-request image as an initial empty state, which did not substantiate an honest empty daily chart.
findings.resolution: Current source-bound zero-ledger screenshots explicitly display 0 requests, $0.00 costs and no-activity text on desktop/mobile for each metric. The earlier populated image remains historical evidence rather than being relabeled empty.

findings.observation: Fe5 protected mobile dossier exposed serious scrollable-region-focusable on the account request-history overflow wrapper; narrow exact source confirmed no focusable wrapper. This was in the canonical quota journey and was not waived as unrelated baseline debt.
findings.resolution: Current actual mobile trace records Account AI request history as tabindex=0 role=region. Current dossier screenshot/recording and source-bound capture show no serious axe findings or page overflow. Post-experience source confirms shared focus-visible outline and the narrow tabIndex repair. Horizontal scrolling itself is not demonstrated in the sampled protected recording.

limitations: Acceptance applies only to this bounded Creator/Admiralty correction. Owner acceptance is NOT_CLAIMED.
Historical fe5 full light/populated/adverse/table assets are supplementary and retain their original source identity; no fresh current AI camera/readability or paid model rendering is credited.
Recorded transitions inspected as four decoded frames per recording plus screenshots/trace/receipt; continuous playback smoothness is not independently accepted.
No Player Lens refit, publication-to-Player end-to-end proof, physical touch/AR quality, production quota/invoice proof or real private content was reviewed.

composition.observation: Current screenshots place the blue room preview between the tool rail and right inspector, with bottom timeline and Assistant over the existing scene. The floating and docked panels overlap rather than replace the preview. Historical fe5 full light-theme/populated dock captures were inspected separately; narrow source diff confirms authoring runtime presentation unchanged.

hierarchy.observation: Desk Map and Working draft saved occupy separate title/status lines. Workspace selectors and tool modes sit below them. Assistant separates selected-object context, invitation, composer and unavailable-state feedback. Historical Guided, Detailed and Engineering captures show progressively exposed controls instead of duplicated blank panes.

typography.observation: Desk Map, Spatial Assistant and the returned Voyagewright Studio page title have distinct scale and weight. Composer helper text and unavailable-state text remain legible in full mobile images. Historical light screenshots preserve this hierarchy with dark ink on pale surfaces.

spacing.observation: Current header gives title and draft status separate vertical space; portrait controls wrap into distinct rows. Assistant composer has separate request field and action row. Historical full light and Engineering screenshots establish populated dock section spacing; current protected capture primarily uses Guided with closed left panels.

controls.observation: Actual keyboard recordings open Ask Parallax, activate Dock assistance with an explicit Float assistance return, close assistance and follow Creator Studio back to the library. View canvas and ordinary editor controls remain visible. Current unavailable-state message explicitly keeps manual editing available.

contrast.observation: Blue controls and pale text stand apart from navy panes and scene walls. Focused controls have a bright cyan outline. The unavailable-state message is text, independent of icon/color; historical full light appearance shows corresponding blue controls and dark labels on pale authoring surfaces.

consistency.observation: Assistant border/action blue repeats inspector selections and the dark room palette. The Creator account header and returned library preserve the accepted gateway navigation family. Gateway references were inspected as shell references only and do not supply Studio design acceptance.

states.observation: Current protected images establish editor ready, Assistant ready, Assistant docked and library return for desktop/mobile normal/reduced motion. They visibly include the safe unavailable-assistance state. Historical fe5 populated, loading, proposal and provider-failure images remain distinct evidence and preserve the original F1 repair history.

responsive.observation: At 390px the editor controls wrap and the Assistant occupies most of the viewport while View canvas and Close remain reachable. Desktop floating/docked assistance leaves the same preview frame behind it. Historical fe5 measurements across 1440/1280/390/844 demonstrate unchanged canvas bounds; landscape remains constrained and requires internal panel scrolling.

keyboard.observation: Current actual protected actions tab to and activate Studio entry, Ask Parallax, Dock assistance, Close and Creator Studio return. Capture receipt reports keyboard operation for all four device/motion combinations. No touch, AR or physical keyboard ergonomic acceptance is inferred.

focus.observation: Current editor-ready screenshots focus Desk Map; ready/docked images show focus around the activated assistance control. Returned headings identify the destination. The repaired proposal-focus test now waits for the existing passive focus effect; that harness-only change does not introduce a new rendered behavior claim.

feedback.observation: Current unavailable message says scenes are safe and manual editing can continue. Protected measured visible-action feedback ranges from 610.66 to 967.73ms against a 3000ms budget. These are retained capture measurements, not independent stopwatch results; historical fe5 provider failure shows its explanation beside the retained request.

motion.observation: Normal and reduced recordings both retain editor-entry, overlay/dock and return meaning; reduced preference is verified by capture receipt. Four sampled moments per recording were visually inspected. This does not qualify continuous animation smoothness or a physical mobile device.

continuity.observation: All four protected Studio journeys preserve the same hashed Creator identity before, at outcomes and after return. Current frames show the same synthetic account header, Desk Map context and canonical Voyagewright Studio library. Opening assistance does not remove the scene or change Creator role.

complexity.observation: Guided mode keeps inspector groups collapsed while scene tools and Assistance remain available. Historical populated Detailed and Engineering views expose transforms and coordinate evidence in appropriate sections. Left hierarchy/library and bottom timeline/simulation/diagnostics are functional content, not placeholder labels in the reviewed historical captures.

role-outcomes.observation: The authenticated Creator enters from the canonical library, reviews usable contextual assistance over the actual editor, docks/closes it and returns to the same library. This bounded authoring correction is supported; it does not complete Creator-to-Player publication, Player Lens refit or physical scene quality.

fallbacks.observation: Current unavailable-assistance text explicitly preserves manual editing and guided placement controls. Historical fe5 provider-failure rendering exposes the explanation with a retained request, resolving concealed recovery feedback. Account allowance and provider absence do not remove ordinary authoring controls; no current paid model or new AI-camera output is claimed.

findings.observation: Initial f6 provider failure put its explanation below the welcome area outside the visible panel, hiding sighted recovery feedback.
findings.resolution: Previously reviewed fe5 adverse capture shows the provider-failure explanation beside the retained request; current source-bound mobile ready/docked screenshots visibly expose unavailable assistance and manual-edit recovery without hiding controls. Authoring runtime presentation is unchanged since the reviewed repair.
